name: banza-operator-manifest
description: banza-operator-manifest (BX1.6): local, no-network technical validation of a candidate operator manifest. It validates the canonical OperatorManifest (per contracts/openapi + conformance vectors MAN-001..004) plus a DRAFT candidate-submission extension, and computes status/readiness/hashes IN RUST. A valid manifest is technical evidence — it NEVER certifies, approves, creates an operator, or changes /operators.
